question.text: Exposure limits to sectors and entities in a PMS portfolio are MOSTLY aimed at managing:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per-sector and per-entity caps prevent concentration risk. The Trap: Currency and fraud concerns need other controls. Cross-Exam Context: Same guidance in NISM III-A/III-C Compliance. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Set hard caps (e.g., 10% per stock, 25% per sector) and monitor daily.
